title: all together now: random forests analysis reveals the joint impact of multiple statistical regularities on eye‑movements during reading
core_idea: Use random forests on a large-scale eye-movement passage-reading dataset (English first- and second-language readers) to evaluate the relative importance of many statistical regularities—across word- and text-levels (e.g., predictability, print-speech, print-meaning)—on multiple eye-movement dependent variables, and to test whether different regularities provide unique explanatory power beyond collinear cues and vary across processing stages.
tldr: Apply random forest analyses to a large eye-movement corpus to assess how multiple statistical regularities at different linguistic levels jointly influence reading behavior, focusing on unique contributions and temporal variation across processing stages.
